# Okinawa Rental Nice Okinawa

> English-first information and inquiry site for Okinawa car rental, snorkel gear, BBQ sets, fishing equipment and travel items with pickup and delivery options.

Commercial intent: Okinawa rental service — car rental support, snorkel gear, BBQ sets & fishing equipment. Pickup & delivery across Okinawa.

Canonical URL: https://rental.nice.okinawa/
Booking email: info@nice.okinawa
Service area: Okinawa, Japan

## Services

- Car rental: From compact economy to luxury convertible — multiple partner garages across Okinawa. Pickup & drop-off available at hotels, ports or airports.
- Snorkel kit: Life jacket, mask, fins — everything you need to jump into Okinawa's clear water right from a roadside beach. Add to car rental or book standalone. Delivery to hotel available.
- Beach BBQ: Beachside BBQ with full setup — equipment, charcoal and ingredients included. We handle venue reservation. Show up and grill.
- Fishing gear: Full tackle rental — rods, reels, cooler box and basic accessories. Easy to add to a car rental for relaxed shore fishing along the coast.
- GoPro / Underwater Camera: Capture your snorkel sessions and fishing fights. Available on request — limited units so book in advance.
- Family Car / Convertible: Family cars, SUVs, MPVs, convertibles and premium models — we match the vehicle to your route, luggage, group size and island mood.
- Golf: Okinawa has world-class golf courses with ocean views. We handle tee-time booking, transport and equipment rental.
- Snorkel Tour: Guided snorkel tours from Ginowan Port. Perfect for first-timers. Guides, safety gear and marine life spotting included.

Prices, vehicle types, delivery availability, venue reservations, equipment availability and booking details vary and must be confirmed before booking.

## Pickup and delivery

Pickup & drop-off available at hotels, ports or airports.
Add to car rental for a bundle deal. Delivery to hotel or port.

## Booking information to provide

Tell us your dates, hotel or pickup point, group size and the gear you need. We will reply by email, WhatsApp or WeChat.

## FAQ excerpt

- Can I pick up the car at my hotel? Yes — we offer pickup and drop-off at hotels, ports and the airport. Just let us know your location when booking.
- Do I need a Japanese driver's licence? An International Driving Permit (IDP) is required for most foreign nationals driving in Japan. We'll confirm requirements for your country when you enquire.
- Can I add snorkel gear to an existing car rental? Absolutely. Even if you booked your car elsewhere, we can deliver snorkel gear to your hotel or vehicle pickup point.
- What's included in the BBQ booking? The beach BBQ venue includes equipment, charcoal and ingredients. We handle the reservation — you just bring yourselves and your appetite.
- What languages do you support? We handle everything in English, Mandarin Chinese and Japanese. Other languages — give it a try, we'll figure it out.
